verdict.rationale: Kling documents image and video as generation inputs: an MVL framework that treats image and video as input modalities, Image to Video, and priced video generation 'with video input'. That supports pointing at reference media to generate new footage. However, no evidence explicitly describes using a reference to transfer or match its visual style; image-to-video reads as start/end-frame conditioning rather than style referencing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of reference-based style transfer to new footage, details of how video-reference conditioning works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a creator, I can point at a reference video or image and generate new footage in that style
